description: CI/CD Workflow Fixes and Enhancements - Fix any issues with existing CI workflows (PR Labeler, CI tests), enhance workflow reliability.
steps: Analyze .github/workflows/label.yml for potential issues - the workflow uses actions/labeler@v5 with sync-labels which should work
Verify .github/labeler.yml syntax matches actions/labeler@v5 format (already using correct 'changed-files' and 'any-glob-to-any-file' syntax)
Review .github/workflows/ci.yml - check if npm run format -- --check is correct or if it should be npm run format:check
Add format:check script to package.json if it doesn't exist: "format:check": "prettier --check ."
Review .github/workflows/npm-publish.yml for proper npm publishing setup
Add workflow dispatch triggers where missing for manual runs
Ensure all workflows have proper concurrency groups to cancel duplicate runs
acceptance_criteria: CI workflow can run npm run format:check or equivalent
All workflows have workflow_dispatch for manual triggers
PR Labeler workflow is correctly configured
verification: npm run format:check or npm run format -- --check
Test npm run scripts referenced in CI
findings: CI/CD workflows fixed and enhanced: (1) Added format:check script to package.json for proper formatting verification in CI, (2) Updated ci.yml to use npm run format:check instead of npm run format -- --check which was incorrectly modifying files during CI, (3) Removed NODE_OPTIONS: --experimental-vm-modules from release.yml and npm-publish.yml (this flag was causing Node 20 failures). All workflows already have proper concurrency groups and workflow_dispatch triggers. PR Labeler configuration (.github/labeler.yml) is correctly configured for actions/labeler@v5 format with changed-files and any-glob-to-any-file syntax. All 1211 tests pass. Lint passes with 0 errors (191 warnings). Format check passes.
